desc:
🌪️ CHASE A TORNADO! 🌪️

Grab your gear, jump in your truck and race into the storm! Track tornadoes on your radar, get as close as you dare and capture the shot of a lifetime - but don't get caught in the vortex!

🚙 DRIVE - Chase storms in trucks, interceptors and armored vehicles. Upgrade and customize them in your garage.
📸 FILM - Take photos and record video of tornadoes. The closer and clearer the shot, the more cash you earn!
📡 DEPLOY - Drop probes in the tornado's path and set up weather stations to collect research.
🗺️ 2 MAPS - Great Plains (Easy) and Dixie Alley (Medium), each with its own dangers: fallen trees, rain-wrapped tornadoes and much more.
👥 TEAM UP - Chase alone or with up to 4 friends in one vehicle.
⭐ LEVEL UP - Complete contracts, open crates, keep your daily streak and fill your Storm Journal.

📱 Play on PC, mobile or controller!

Bank your haul before the storm gets you. Good luck, chaser! 🌩️
